newsitem.title: USA: MERCHANTS BANK NAMES JANET SPITLER CFO.
newsitem.headline: MERCHANTS BANK NAMES JANET SPITLER CFO.

text.p: Merchants Bank said today that it has named Janet Spitler chief financial officer. Spitler, said the bank, has been with it for nearly seven years, most recently as controller.
The bank also said that it has named Michael Tuttle chief operating officer. Tuttle joined Merchants Bank in 1995 and was previously executive vice-president and senior credit officer.
Bank representatives were not immediately available for further comment.
Reached later by phone, Merchants said that both positions had been vacant since the bank underwent a restructuring in 1995.
